name: Laughter
q: Nothing to lose, might as well laugh
Even a fake laugh is still a laugh
The human race has one really effective weapon, laughter
A day without laughter is a day wasted
No one spits on a smiling face
Laughter is sunshine that chases winter away
If I laugh, it is that I may not weep
Laugh, and the world laughs with you
Laughter is the property of man
This crown of the laughter, I myself have set it on my head
Against the assault of laughter nothing can stand
What forbids truth said with a laugh?
With mirth and laughter let old wrinkles come
